name: @local/dsh-ascii-ocean
description: Five whale species with shaded cells or ASCII fill; every content card and the input box is frosted glass with whales blurred behind it, plus independent random dives, tail-stroke ripples, optional input-box avoidance, occasional random spouts, drifting ASCII wind and cloud shadows, continuous toroidal swimming, a whale-size slider, and in-place config updates that never restart the school.
